newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - Feb 3.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - Feb 3.

text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Indonesian press on February 3. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Copper and gold miner PT Freeport Indonesia and the country's richest man Soedono Salim (Lim Sioe Liong) have been named by the government as the biggest corporate and private taxpayers in 1995.
Military authorities in West Kalimantan say the situation has returned to normal in the province on the island of Borneo after rioting and disturbances there last week.

Indonesian Catholic leader Cardinal Julius Darmoatmodjo deplored the recent riots which have rocked the country and said an overwhelming moral decadence was behind the recent spate of violent incidents.

The flow of people millions of Jakarta residents out of the Indonesian capital ahead of the Eid al-Fitr holiday next weekend has began to increase drastically as bus operators illegally increase their fares.
Scholars have called for an independent team to be set up to investigate the causes behind a number of recent riots.
